{{Navbox/Stats}}
{{stat|Mana}} is a resource used by cats and very few other units to cast [[spells]].

Only player cats, {{en|Druid's Crow}} and the {{en|Mech Suit}} use mana and can interact with it.

== Notes ==
* All units technically have mana, and have it visible if they are an allied familiar, but it cannot be interacted with in any way.
